trails.name: Rota do Glaciar

trails.name: Rota da Reboleira
trails.why: On the Route de la Reboleira you can see landscapes marked by human presence, through the villages that mark the bright green of the horizon in white, by the carvings carved into the ground, lamber trees, leafy forests and uncultivated pasture areas.

trails.name: Rota da Vinha e do Vinho
